BiblicalUsage: Jeaterai is named once, in the line of the Gershonite Levites, the son of Zerah in the house of Gershon. He stands in the line of Levi, between Joah and Iddo in the genealogy of the singers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the singers' lines as carefully as the kings', and Jeaterai is named because the music matters.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
